definitions.explanation: The look and feel of a material or surface — how something feels to the touch or appears in terms of material quality. Commonly used in fashion, design, and product descriptions.

examples.japanese: この{革|かわ}は{質感|しつかん}がいい。
examples.english: This leather has a nice texture.

examples.japanese: {高級|こうきゅう}な{質感|しつかん}の{生地|きじ}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: It uses fabric with a luxurious feel.

examples.japanese: この{塗料|とりょう}を{使|つか}えば、{木|き}の{質感|しつかん}を{活|い}かした{仕上|しあ}がりになる。
examples.english: Using this paint will give a finish that brings out the texture of the wood.

notes: Combines {質|しつ} (quality) and {感|かん} (feeling/sensation). Frequently used in product reviews, interior design, and fashion: {質感|しつかん}がいい (has a nice feel), {質感|しつかん}が{高|たか}い (feels high-quality). Also used in visual arts and CG graphics to describe how realistic a surface looks.
